subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram inbound update is permanently lost after offset persistence with no ingress, spool, or dispatch

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the unresolved no-ingress/no-spool signature while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113368 owns offset ordering and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113667 owns bot-scoped dedupe collisions?
rationale: The available evidence separates at least one dedupe collision from the original report, but does not prove whether the remaining no-ingress/no-spool observation is a third defect or an instrumentation gap; only the Telegram-area owner can decide the durable tracking and proof boundary.

options.title: Keep the issue canonical
options.body: Retain this issue for the no-ingress/no-spool investigation and require each related PR to state the exact manifestation it does and does not fix.

options.title: Split after owner confirmation
options.body: Create or nominate a narrower follow-up only if the owner can demonstrate that the remaining observation is a distinct component with an independent reproduction.

recommendation.title: Keep the issue canonical
recommendation.body: Retain this issue for the no-ingress/no-spool investigation and require each related PR to state the exact manifestation it does and does not fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged isolated-ingress recovery history makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for deciding the remaining recovery and observability boundary.
